title: FinalProofResponse
description: Proof's answer in proof@1's form, with what of it quotes a test left out: a failing case's message that shares a run of 20 characters with a kept test is empty, and a detail or reason that does is replaced by a sentence saying so; and what the built mode answered to the design's worked examples, whose verdicts are taken out of proof's answer.

setting.description: settings.forge.tryExamples when the examples were tried: must when it is left out.

head.description: The commit the examples were tried on.

carried.description: Whether the slice's request carried any of the design's examples.

results.description: Each example of the slice's actions, in the design's order, with what came back: as designed, refused by its request schema, otherwise with both sides, not known or not tried with the reason. The built mode's words are kept from it when they quote a kept test beyond the design's examples.

tried.description: What the built mode answered to the design's worked examples, each tried in a throwaway copy of the head of its own.
